{{Quote|Hello stranger. I have never seen you here before. I am Teemto, one of Mos Espa's most famous racers.|Teemto Pagalies, to Qui-Gon Jinn|<ref name="TPMvg">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' video game]]</ref>}}
'''Teemto Pagalies''' was a [[Veknoid/Legends|Veknoid]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who competed in the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] race in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|It was fast.''"<br />"''That's all? Just fast?''"<br />"''Real fast.|Teemto Pagalies and Leia Organa discussing Pagalies's podracing days|<ref name="TG">''[[Tatooine Ghost]]''</ref>}}[[File:Teemto_pagalies.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Teemto Pagalies during the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]].]]
Considered handsome by [[Veknoid/Legends|Veknoid]] standards, Teemto Pagalies was exiled from his home planet after unwittingly attracting the attention of a beautiful Veknoid princess and resisting her attempts at matrimony. Subsequently, he became a fringer, desperately trying to find work in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], but he could find solace nowhere. As a last resort (some might say as a suicide attempt) Pagalies tried [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]], and he finally found his talent. He used an [[IPG-X1131 LongTail/Legends|IPG-X1131 Longtail]].

When he came to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], he became infatuated with the Twi'lek [[Ann Gella/Legends|Ann Gella]], a masseuse of [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]], but he could not get her to notice him. He also managed to buy a slave [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] mechanic from [[Mars Guo/Legends|Mars Guo]] called [[Pax Bonkik]].<ref name="PB">{{DB|character|paxbonkik|Bonkik, Pax}}</ref>

Teemto Pagalies also attended [[Boles Roor/Legends|Boles Roor's]] glimmik concert prior to the race, in which he found out that Mars Guo was hitting on Ann Gella, offering to take her away from the planet if he won the race. Frustrated, Pagalies told Sebulba about the affair and the notorious [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] took Guo out during the race in retaliation.<ref name="PT">"[[Podracing Tales]]"</ref>{{Quote|I can drink five times as much as any being three times my height.|Teemto Pagalies|<ref name="TPMvg" />}}
In the [[7-Gee Lounge]] before the race, Pagalies, a notorious drunkard, had more than a few [[Juri juice/Legends|Juri juices]]. A professional hit man named [[Jym Lang]] had been hired by [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] to capture the unsuspecting, half-drunken [[Veknoid/Legends|Veknoid]] to be fed to the [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlacc]]. However, his life was saved by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], who purposely gave Lang the wrong coordinates of Teemto just moments before the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] had plotted to carry out the deed.<ref name="TPMvg" />

Pagalies considered [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin]] a "good kid", and wished him well in the race. Despite his drunkenness, he kept close track of everyone involved in podracing, including [[Watto/Legends|Watto]].

Of the pilots who entered the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]], Pagalies' Podracer boasted the longest engines, and he was confident that between this and the internal stabilizer ring built into his Pod, [[Teemto Pagalies' Podracer/Legends|Pagalies' Podracer]] was technologically superior and could not help but win.<ref name="TPP">{{DB|vehicle|teemtopagaliespodracer|Podracer, Teemto Pagalies'}}</ref>

Unfortunately, his lofty theories were proved incorrect by a well-placed potshot from the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] [[Orr Agg R'orr]] in the [[Canyon Dune Turn/Legends|Canyon Dune Turn]], destroying his engines and sending his Pod whirling into the air.<ref name="TPMBH">{{Film|I}}; Orr Agg R'orr identified in ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]''</ref> Pagalies sustained some injuries from the incident, including having his ears melted off, but recovered fairly quickly and soon returned to the races.

In response to Pagalies' accident, his family put a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on Orr Agg R'orr; 3,000 credits for the Tusken's death. This reward was claimed a few months later by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]].<ref name="BH">''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]''</ref>

Soon afterwards, Pagalies was racing in the [[Vinta Harvest Classic/Legends|Vinta Harvest Classic]], apparently with healed ears (or prosthetics). He made the mistake of taunting Sebulba in the starting blocks, and Sebulba reacted by injuring Pagalies's lower back before the race. Pagalies nevertheless finished this new race alive.<ref name="EtM">''[[Star Wars: Emissaries to Malastare]]''</ref> He was later seen celebrating in the [[Seko Cantina]], in [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]<ref name="RTl">[[Star Wars (1998) 21|''Star Wars'' (1998) 21]]</ref>

[[File:TeemtoPagaliesTwilight.jpg|thumb|200px|Teemto Pagalies in the [[Seko Cantina]] on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]].]]

He came to be known for trying daring stunts and became a great crowd pleaser. In one such stunt, Pagalies lost one of his eyes in the resulting crash. Though he jumped around Podracing planets for a while, he eventually settled on the spice-mining world of [[Mon Gazza/Legends|Mon Gazza]], where the long, open tracks were perfect for the feats he was able to coax out of his Podracer.

Some time later, Pagalies won the [[Aleen/Legends|Aleen]] Classic and planned to use the prize money to buy Ann Gella's freedom from Sebulba. But since he knew that his mechanic's brother, [[Trax Bonkik]], was also owned by Sebulba, he used the money instead to buy Trax's freedom in the last moment; therefore reuniting the brothers.<ref name="PB" />

In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], Pagalies was working in the old [[Mos Espa Grand Arena/Legends|Mos Espa Grand Arena]] (now a [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] arena) for [[Ulda]], alongside his previous competitor [[Ody Mandrell/Legends|Ody Mandrell]]. By this point he had also lost an arm. It was at the Arena that Pagalies was questioned by [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] about the truth behind [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|her father's]] victory at the Boonta Eve Classic so many years previously.<ref name="TG" />

He was still alive in [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], when he sent Leia Organa Solo a copy of a video of Anakin Skywalker's win in the aforementioned race.<ref name="Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Follow too close and you'll get cooked.|translated=1|Teemto Pagalies was voiced by [[Michael Sorich]]|<ref name="Star Wars Episode I: Racer">[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Racer'']]</ref>}}
Teemto Pagalies was created for the [[1999]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']], but first appeared in the film's [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|novelization]] by [[Terry Brooks]]. Conceptual art for the character, including bone structure, was created by concept artist [[Terryl Whitlatch]]. The character's surname is mispelled 'Pugales' in Todd Strasser's 1999 Scholastic book, [[Star Wars Journal: Anakin Skywalker|''Star Wars Episode I Journal: Anakin Skywalker'']].
